name: WF - Meeting Room: Book, Approve, Cancel

parameters.functionCode:
const item = $input.first().json;
const body = item.body || item;
const headers = item.headers || {};
const authHeader = headers.authorization || '';
return [{ json: {
  token: authHeader.replace('Bearer ', ''),
  authHeader,
  room_id: body.room_id || '',
  room_name: body.room_name || '',
  meeting_date: body.meeting_date || '',
  start_time: body.start_time || '',
  end_time: body.end_time || '',
  purpose: body.purpose || '',
  attendees: parseInt(body.attendees || 1),
  priority: body.priority || 'normal',
  notes: body.notes || '',
  requester_name: body.requester_name || '',
  requester_email: body.requester_email || '',
  department: body.department || '',
  backendUrl: ($env.BACKEND_URL || 'http://backend:3001') + '/api/meeting-room',
  frontendUrl: $env.FRONTEND_URL || 'https://approvehub.internalautomation.io.vn' } }];
